title: No Support of Sony Smartwatch 3 SW50 since latest DEV (2.8.2) version
symptom: After building AAPS 2.8.2 DEV in Android Studio and installing it on the smartphone, the Sony Smartwatch 3 SW50 is not updated anymore. Installing the newest 2.8.2 watch.APK via ADB to the smartwatch fails, while the 2.8.2 master version installs fine.
evidence_quote: I cannot check that again, because I switched to the new Samsung Watch 4. Before that I stayed on the master 2.8.1 and that was ok on the SWR50. As you mentioned, it seems that in RC3 the problems are solved.
